id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Ahhh! Here we are in beautiful Lonalulu, a seaside paradise that Shell tells me is home to the prettiest pearls in the world!
"Bright blue waves, pure-white sands and fabulous jewels just lying on the beach! Truly, darlings, this is the promised land!
"...Although it does seem a little less promising than I expected. Where is everybody?
"Something's not right here. Still, it's not our problem. Let's find this Kai guy and get out of here.
